text: The bakery should definitely launch the new sourdough line. Evidence supporting this decision includes both options A and B. Kitchen allergen isolation protocols ensure all new ingredients will be safe and reliable. Additionally, offering a unique heritage grain blend that competitors do not have is a significant competitive advantage. Furthermore, securing a bulk flour contract with a fifth-cost reduction can significantly lower production costs, making it more financially viable. Lastly, the success of the comparable rye line selling out for six consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand. These factors collectively support the decision to bring their new sourdough line to market.
